summary: Preview of a message and its metadata that reuses the sandboxed preview of EmailBuilder.
whenToUse: Reviewing an existing email document before the app sends it.
whenNotToUse: Composing or sending campaigns: use EmailBuilder and the app's integrations.

keyboard.action: Uses the accessible preview controls of EmailBuilder.

accessibility: Reuses the isolated preview of EmailBuilder with an empty sandboxed iframe.
Metadata structured as a description list.
responsive: Width and viewport are handled by EmailBuilder; metadata wraps.
commonMistakes: Expecting to send the email or edit the document in this read-only preview.
limits: Does not edit or send emails.
